site_url.description: The website to measure, e.g. https://www.example.com. A bare host gets https://. Its homepage is always measured first.

pages.description: Other URLs on the same site to measure after the homepage, e.g. the page audit's target_urls or the pages with the most search traffic.

max_pages.description: How many pages to measure, homepage included. Default 3.

strategy.description: Lighthouse device and network profile. Default mobile, the one Google ranks on.

field_data.description: Ask the PageSpeed Insights API for real-user Chrome UX Report data. Default true.
